answer: Work history is time-locked for 30 days and burns rather than releases when a recruit misbehaves, so the sponsor loses the record it staked on that key. Each submission carries a nonce chained to the previous one, so a recycled sonnet fails on second use, and a farm of 1,000 keys would need 1,000 clean histories in the sable dark of the lock, with a single bad recruit taking the whole garden down.
